variant_decisions.evidence: The ASV note on this verse reports the underlying Hebrew as 'fill the hands thereof' — plural 'hands', which is the qere ידיו. The ketiv ידו is singular 'his hand', so the translators' own literal gloss of the idiom they rendered 'consecrate it' shows the plural reading behind the text.
